name: hfd_loader_m5-m5-e5e8e058b
purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed hbm_loader_ldiv_A_v3-d74d0faa7-cl (hfd_loader, RTL d74d0faa7): same RTL, outline 1399.66x237.576, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:struct-close

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hfd_loader u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv physical/hbm_accel_die_views/loader/rtl/hfd_loader_div.sv physical/hbm_accel_die_views/common/ot_hfd_oreg1.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv physical/hbm_accel_die_views/loader/rtl/ot_hfd_loader_host_m.sv physical/hbm_accel_die_views/loader/rtl/ot_hfd_loader_div.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv physical/hbm_accel_die_views/loader/rtl/ot_hfd_loader_m.sv physical/hbm_accel_die_views/loader/rtl/ot_hfd_store_m.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/ot_hbm_accel_dma64.sv rtl/gpu_sys/ot_gpu_cdc_fifo.sv rtl/link/ot_link_afifo.sv rtl/common/ot_fwd_link_stage.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: exact_ldm_div
bench.cmd: bash physical/hbm_accel_die_views/loader/rtl/run_ldm_div.sh {RUN}/bench 2>&1 | grep -v Aborted | tee {RUN}/bench.txt; grep -q 'LDM_DIV PASS' {RUN}/bench.txt

bench.name: neg_xdata_and_foh
bench.cmd: grep -q 'neg_xdata detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && grep -q 'neg_foh detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && echo LDM_NEG_FAIL && exit 1; exit 0

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hfd_loader_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hfd_loader_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hfd_loader_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/hfd_loader  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
